title: Musk v. Altman week 3: Musk and Altman traded blows over each other’s credibility. Now the jury will pick a side.
brief: Elon Musk and Sam Altman faced final credibility challenges in week 3 of their trial, with lawyers attacking both parties' honesty and motives—Musk portrayed as power-hungry, Altman accused of self-dealing—leaving the jury to determine who to believe on the core questions of OpenAI's founding agreement and direction.
